values.note: Water-and-electric pads: $24 a night for Rock Island County residents, $27 for others, $23 for seniors over 62. Primitive sites are $17 ($20 on the river) for residents, $3 more for non-residents. Paid at the camp office.

note: Rock Island County Forest Preserve District park on the Mississippi at Hampton. The water-and-electric RV pads sit on open lawn 150-200 m back from the river, past the park road and picnic lawn; 17 of the primitive sites line the shore road on the riverfront. --Claude
summary: District pages read via headless Chrome (plain HTTP Cloudflare 403). Confirmed FCFS (reservations for youth groups only), 60 water/electric pads (count 85 -> 60, primitive noted apart), showers, dump, 14-day limit, season first weekend Apr - last weekend Oct (2026 opened Apr 3). Rate added: $24 resident / $27 non-resident / $23 senior. Riverview kept on imagery (pads ~150-200 m back on open lawn). Website moved.
flags: WEBSITE: https://www.ricfpd.org/illiniwek-forest-preserve -> https://www.ricfpd.org/preserves/illiniwek-forest-preserve/ (old path redirects; new path is the current page). Camping detail lives at https://www.ricfpd.org/activities/camping/.
PHONE: 309-496-2620 confirmed (Campground Office, April-October). Off-season: maintenance (309) 203-1404, district office (309) 795-1040.

WATERFRONT: riverview kept. RV pads (inland loop beside the railroad, ~41.5640,-90.4024) are ~150-200 m from the Mississippi across open lawn with the park road, picnic area and shore road between - a view, not frontage; no levee. LEAD (not an upgrade): primitive sites 1-17 sit on the shore road 'within feet of the Mississippi Riverfront' ($20/$23 'River Site'); the pages don't say whether an RV may use a primitive site (rule 7 bars tents from RV sites, nothing bars RVs from primitive ones). The old note's 'tent-only' is not on any district page and was dropped.
